QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_40

question.text: The current Cat III AIF market status reflects:

answer.text: Indian Category III AIFs are nascent and poised to grow; overall registered AIFs numbered 1,748 as of January 7, 2025 and commitments across all registered AIF categories surpassed Rs. 13.49 lakh crore as of March 31, 2025

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 48 of the Series-XIX-B workbook states that Indian Category III AIFs are nascent and poised to grow. Page 40 separately gives the broader registration data: 1,748 AIFs registered as of January 7, 2025 and commitments across all registered AIF categories surpassing Rs. 13.49 lakh crore as of March 31, 2025. The Trap: The 1,748 count and Rs. 13.49 lakh crore figure are industry-wide AIF statistics, not Category III-only metrics; "mature stable", "declining" and "pilot" descriptors do not fit the workbook's nascent-but-growing characterisation. Note: The keyed option deliberately separates the Category III qualitative description (page 48) from the overall AIF quantitative data (page 40) to avoid misattributing industry totals to Category III alone.
